question: What was the return on investment (ROI) for Applied Materials, Inc. if $100 was invested in the company's common stock on October 27, 2013, and sold two years later, considering the cumulative total stockholder return as presented in the performance graph of the 2018 report?
retrieval_query: Applied Materials, Inc. return on investment ROI October 27 2013 cumulative total stockholder return 2018 report
answer:
The return on investment (ROI) for Applied Materials, Inc. is calculated using the performance graph data from the 2018 report. The graph shows that if $100 was invested on October 27, 2013, and held until October 28, 2018, the value of the investment grew to $171.11.

ROI is calculated as:

(Ending Value - Beginning Value) / Beginning Value  
= (171.11 - 100) / 100  
= 71.11 / 100  
= 0.7111 or 71.11%

Source: finqa_test_ctx_7.pdf p.1
